rule: A pin may not be quoted beyond its tier. A figure presented as fact needs a source read at proof tier. A citation that did not resolve is recorded as a negative reading, never as support. This ledger cites only what the mark itself cites: no substitute source is introduced here, so the mark's own citations are the thing being graded.
measured: All seven evidence_url values were requested from this host on 2026-11-04. Six failed: four HTTP 404 (Microsoft, Apple, Intel, Sonos), one HTTP 404 (the repair.org Deere PDF), one host that did not resolve (hop.asso.fr). One returned HTTP 200 (developer.android.com Play Integrity overview), and that page is a product overview carrying no device population.

declared_gaps.title: Emotional-equivalence intensity has no evidentiary standard
declared_gaps.why: The mark scores each wound with an intensity float and calls the sum 'total emotional damage'. No recognised forum receives an intensity scale as evidence of harm, so no gate is implemented that would convert it into a finding. The checker records the layer as a declaration at tier C and refuses to let it count toward any figure, which is why the gap is declared rather than filled with an invented test.

Two pillars still name no source at proof tier for the vendor's own conduct: the printer firmware mechanism rests on a complainant's own investigation (tier C) and the Deere mechanism cites the statutory instrument rather than a Deere document. A live, readable vendor or court record is required before either premise is proven.
